title: Publication of the Necronomicon financed by Larry Barnes

tellings.quote: So by finally by 1977 uh by December of 77 there was a completed actual book for sale.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer on secret history and the occult, says he worked on publishing a book called the Necronomicon in New York, presented as an ancient book of magic. He says the work began in the mid-1970s with money from a man named Larry Barnes and help from Herman Slater, and that by December 1977 a finished book was for sale.
